comment:
* GCM parameters used during an ciphering operation with {@link OpenSSLCipher}. * This class is used internally for backward compatibility with Android versions * that did not have the {@code GCMParameterSpec} class, in addition to being the * implementation of the GCM AlgorithmParameters implementation. *

* The only supported encoding format is ASN.1, as specified in RFC 5084 section 3.2. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: DEFAULT_TLEN
variables.comment: The default value (in bits) for TLEN in the GCM ASN.1 module

variables.name: iv
variables.comment: Actually the nonce value for the GCM operation.

methods.name: int getTLen()
methods.comment: * Returns the tag length in bits.

methods.name: byte[] getIV()
methods.comment: * Returns a non-cloned version of the IV.
